edges.subject: CLN5
edges.quote: Homozygous variants in the neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis type 5 (CLN5) gene are associated with neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis, a progressive neurologic disorder that leads to ataxia, seizures, and early death.
